concerns.text: FR-001 and US-1 require downloading a balanced set of abstracts from ML and non-ML venues. Task T011 is marked as unchecked `[ ]` in the task list, creating a critical gap where the primary data acquisition logic for the entire study is missing implementation coverage.

FR-003 and US-2 require generating 50 pattern-guided and 50 baseline proposals (two-arm study). Task T024-gen is marked unchecked `[ ]`. Without this task, the core experimental manipulation and the generation of the `generated_proposals.jsonl` artifact are not covered.
FR-003 requires strict validation of the two-arm structure (no random group). Task T024-val-sch is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the schema validation for the generated proposals uncovered.
FR-003 requires exactly 100 rows (50/50 split). Task T024-val-count is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the row count validation uncovered.
US-3 and the Assumptions section require post-hoc power analysis to verify statistical power. Task T024b is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the power analysis configuration and verification uncovered.
FR-004 requires blind distribution of proposals to experts. Task T059a is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the critical step of preparing blinded data for human evaluation uncovered.
FR-004 requires expert recruitment and rating collection. Task T065-auto is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the automated recruitment pipeline (or the logic to trigger it) uncovered.
The pipeline requires a trigger to proceed from recruitment to ingestion. Task T065-trigger is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the hand-off logic uncovered.
FR-004 requires loading real expert ratings. Task T065-real is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the ingestion of the actual study data uncovered.
US-3 requires testing the ingestion pipeline with mock data. Task T030-test is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the unit test coverage for the loader uncovered.
FR-004 requires the final analysis to use real ratings. Task T030-real is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the production path for loading real data uncovered.

SC-004 requires measuring the validity of pattern mapping via `validity_metrics.json`. Task T036 is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the calculation of the mean difference in contextual alignment scores uncovered.
FR-006 requires the phrase 'associational, not causal' in the report. Task T037 is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the verification of this rhetorical constraint uncovered.
FR-004 requires strict blind evaluation (metadata stripped). Task T072 is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the explicit metadata stripping logic uncovered.
The pipeline requires robust real data ingestion triggers. Task T073 is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the validation of the real data file (header/row count) uncovered.
FR-004 requires expert domain validation via ORCID. Task T074 is unchecked `[ ]`, leaving the logic to parse and match expert domains uncovered.

Task T067 is listed in 'Phase 10' as a 'Review-Driven Revision' but is also listed in 'Phase 5' (T067 [US3]). This creates a duplicate entry and potential confusion about which task is the source of truth for the outlier handling documentation.
Task T068 is listed in 'Phase 10' as a revision but also appears in 'Phase 5' (T068 [US3]). This duplication suggests a stale tag or copy-paste error from an older plan version.
